name: William Crandall, land agent

proprietors.name: William Crandall
proprietors.basis: ADOPTED, NOT MINTED. William Crandall is the reconstructed trade head the resident band's `trade_households` stage drew at land_agent in the north division (slot trade_households:persons/male/20_29/north/family/trade:land_agent:019), and that card says itself that the business band adopts these heads rather than minting its own. Here the head is not merely the proprietor of the house — the head IS what bought it, because no count of this class was ever printed to be short of.

locations.basis: A FACE, NOT A PREMISES. The placement rule for a land office kept by a north-division household deals this house onto North Water Street; the face is drawn on the seed printed in `reconstruction.seed` from the faces that rule allows, and no lot, roof or coordinate is claimed. T-1195 writes the placement policy with its evidence and T-1199 seats this house on the lot grid.
locations.limit_reason: No source places this house, because no source names it: it exists because the resident band drew a land agent the town was short of, and the trade names the house he keeps. The street is the reconstruction's own deal and stops there.

dates.basis: NOTHING DATES THIS HOUSE. The head who keeps it is ordered onto the scene date and to nothing narrower, and a keeping is not an opening; the record claims that the house was trading on 1835-07-01 and nothing about either end.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read yankee: William Crandall (yankee). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A register, directory or deed naming a real land office in the north division in 1835 — that house takes this slot and this record is withdrawn with the head.

trade_head.note: A TRADE HEAD, NOT A SHORTFALL AND NOT A ROOF. The December 1835 State census's eighteen lines never reach this class, so the order book holds no bucket to point at and no count of it can be short; and nothing in data/structures/ is a land office, so there is no committed building to buy the firm either. What IS committed is the man: the resident band drew William Crandall at land agent because the 1839 trade table says the town was short of the trade, and a land agent kept an office and the register prints three houses of the trade — J. C. Goodhue, land agent; W. G. Blanchard, house and land agent, on Lake Street; and one unnamed house and land agent — against a census that enumerates no land office at all. The house is withdrawn with the head.

basis.note: the resident band drew 1 head(s) at land agent in the north division and a land agent kept an office and the register prints three houses of the trade — J. C. Goodhue, land agent; W. G. Blanchard, house and land agent, on Lake Street; and one unnamed house and land agent — against a census that enumerates no land office at all. The style is dealt on the seed printed beside it from the period forms the register itself carries: the same signature with the forename in full, the attested minority form ('Frederick Thomas, drugs and paints', 'William F. Lyon, Wholesale Grocery Store'). The goods line is the trade line the register prints under J. C. Goodhue.

reconstruction.withdrawn_if: the retirement of the head himself, a re-cut of the order book that no longer orders his person bucket, or a source naming a real house of this class; the retirement runs through --build, never by hand
